WITH production_company_type AS (
    SELECT ct.id
    FROM company_type AS ct
    WHERE ct.kind = 'production companies'
),
top_rank_info_type AS (
    SELECT it.id
    FROM info_type AS it
    WHERE it.info = 'top 250 rank'
),
ranked_movie AS (
    SELECT mi_idx.movie_id
    FROM movie_info_idx AS mi_idx
    JOIN top_rank_info_type AS tri ON tri.id = mi_idx.info_type_id
),
note_flags AS (
    SELECT mc.movie_id,
           mc.note,
           (mc.note NOT LIKE '%(as Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer Pictures)%') AS is_not_mgm,
           (mc.note LIKE '%(co-production)%') AS is_co_prod,
           (mc.note LIKE '%(presents)%') AS is_presents
    FROM movie_companies AS mc
    JOIN production_company_type AS pct ON pct.id = mc.company_type_id
),
production_movie_company AS (
    SELECT nf.movie_id,
           nf.note
    FROM note_flags AS nf
    WHERE nf.is_not_mgm = 1
      AND (nf.is_co_prod = 1 OR nf.is_presents = 1)
),
movie_company_note AS (
    SELECT pmc.movie_id,
           MIN(pmc.note) AS note
    FROM production_movie_company AS pmc
    JOIN ranked_movie AS rm ON rm.movie_id = pmc.movie_id
    GROUP BY pmc.movie_id
)
SELECT MIN(mcn.note) AS production_note,
       MIN(t.title) AS movie_title,
       MIN(t.production_year) AS movie_year
FROM movie_company_note AS mcn
JOIN title AS t ON t.id = mcn.movie_id
